query: Complete Delaware 2026 native statewide/district turnout and separate candidate/party results
declaration: The actual GE2026.html page declares results.js. That script derives electionId=GE2026 from the page filename and explicitly constructs all three acquired JSON URLs. Client timestamp query parameters are cache keys, not source update times.
participation: Every native Ballots Cast, Reg Voters and Percentage field is retained for all 41 representative districts and the separate ALL statewide aggregate. All sums and printed percentages independently reconcile.
geography: Representative districts are not counties. No district turnout is apportioned to counties or joined to a fabricated native Census FIPS.
clock: The turnout JSON has no ReportTime or timezone. The separate candidate feed has 2026-11-04T03:03:18.364-05:00; the native page borrows that clock for its display, but this query does not use it as a turnout clock.
registered_voters: The website hardcodes 810,407 in its display. This query instead validates the independently supplied native Reg Voters value and its equality to all 41 district denominators.
candidate_scope: All 124 state candidate/option records and 124 county vectors are preserved separately. Machine/absentee/early choices, county/state vectors and Wilmington plus rest-of-New-Castle subtotals reconcile. Neither candidate selections nor city/county components substitute for participation.
party_labels: All native party IDs/names are retained without collapsing labels. JSON encoding distinguishes null from empty literal party names.
limitations: Candidate reporting denominators vary by contest, including 530 and 527 for statewide races; every native pair is retained. Complete reported pairs and UNOFFICIAL RESULTS do not establish turnout-feed update time, completed all-mode counting, certification, final unique voters, population or demographic participation.
publication: Complete numerical inputs and portable executable query, not an HTML mirror or a live explorer integration.
